title: Contract + pricing fast-path: tiered pricing trigger and legal fastpath for high-risk customers
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: Sales and Legal teams report large variability in time-to-contract for enterprise customers where aggressive pricing experiments (custom tiers/credits) intersect with redline risk on MSA/DPA indemnity and liability. This leads to slow cycles, missed revenue, and ad-hoc concessions that inflate long-term cost.

Objective: Create a clear decision flow and lightweight legal "fast-path" for low-to-medium risk pricing exceptions while ensuring high-risk cases are routed with structured triage. The flow should integrate with our new pricing experiment tool so that certain pricing triggers automatically surface pre-approved legal playbooks (templates, cap bands, and required escalations).

Scope: This ticket covers the product definition, acceptance criteria, and rollout plan for the decision trigger and legal fast-path. It will not implement the UI automation in the sales CRM (separate engineering ticket) nor change the legal MSA text — instead we deliver templates and decision thresholds for Legal to adopt.

Why now: Increasing number of Dedicated and Private deals with bespoke pricing; revenue ops indicates 22% of quotes require >2 legal touchpoints in the last quarter. This is a blocker to scaling Sales-assisted motion for Dedicated/Private customers.
success_metrics: Reduce average time-to-sign for priced exceptions from 18 days to <= 7 days for auto-fastpath cases
Decrease number of legal review rounds by 30% for eligible customers
Maintain <= 10% increase in long-term concessions cost for fast-path approvals versus full-review baseline
non_goals: Changing standard MSA/DPA global language (Legal to handle separately)
Automating signatures or billing integrations (engineering work required in another ticket)
Handling highly regulated/air-gapped customers (these remain high-risk and routed to full review)
proposed_flow: Step 1 — Pricing experiment flag: When Sales selects a non-standard tier or concession in the pricing tool, a "tiered-pricing" flag and a risk score are computed (based on ARR, industry, data-sensitivity, indemnity cap impact).

Step 2 — Fast-path eligibility check: If risk_score <= 3 AND concession <= threshold_by_arr AND customer_tier != 'regulated', the tool surfaces a 'Legal fast-path' package to Sales with an expiration and template bundle.

Step 3 — Fast-path package contents: pre-approved concession language snippets, capped liability buckets (3 tiers), indemnity limited to product/service scope, suggested price offsets, and an automated acceptance checklist for Sales. Templates live in Drive and link to Confluence playbook.

Step 4 — Sales acknowledgement & telemetry: Sales must confirm checklist items; submission logs an auto-ticket to Legal with the selected template. Legal has 48 business hours to override; absent override, the change is auto-approved and can be included with the quote.
Step 5 — High-risk routing: If risk_score > 3 OR customer signals regulated/air-gapped, route to full legal intake with required documents (security questionnaire, risk memo, PRA).
decision_criteria: Risk scoring inputs: ARR band, industry sensitivity (finance/healthcare flagged), requested indemnity cap change, requested data processing scope, presence of escrow or on-prem requirements.

Thresholds: example thresholds initial proposal — risk_score <= 3 and concession <= 15% of quoted ARR for auto-fastpath; concession 15-35% => sales + expedited legal review within 5 business days; >35% => full review.
Escalation: Any request to remove Redwood's exclusion for consequential damages or insurance requirements triggers full review regardless of other scores.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Fast-path approvals increase long-term payouts if thresholds are too loose. Mitigation: conservative initial thresholds + automatic quarterly telemetry review tied to revenue ops to measure concession impact.
Risk: Sales may overuse fast-path to accelerate deals. Mitigation: require Sales checklist + quota of fast-path approvals per AE monitored; anomalies flagged to RevOps.
Risk: Templates might not cover country-specific data residency/legal nuance. Mitigation: Legal maintains exception list; flagged countries force full review.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 — Pilot (Q2): 6-week pilot with 5 strategic AEs and Legal DWG. Track metrics and iterate templates.
Phase 2 — Expand (Q3): Open to full Sales team for Dedicated/Private deals in US/EU; integrate with CRM automation.
Phase 3 — Global & Productize (Q4): Add APAC regions, incorporate in pricing experiment feature flags and policy engine.
acceptance_criteria: Confluence playbook published and Legal sign-off on templates
Pilot telemetry dashboard (time-to-sign, review rounds, concession delta) available in Console
Sales checklist implemented as a templated form and linked from pricing tool
Legal commit to 48 business hour override SLA for auto-fastpath cases for pilot duration
dependencies: LEGAL- intake: policy approval and country exception list (internal legal ticket)
notes: This design intentionally keeps legal text changes minimal — we surface pre-approved snippets and delegation rules rather than committing to new MSA versions. Priya and team requested telemetry hooks for every fast-path approval (who approved, which template chosen, ARR impact).
